mapper.select: SELECT id, name, price, stock, description, image_url, status, category FROM `shangpin` ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, name, price, stock, description, image_url, status, category FROM `shangpin` WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT id, name, price, stock, description, image_url, status, category FROM `shangpin` WHERE status = 1 AND category = #{category} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `shangpin` (name, price, stock, description, image_url, status, category) VALUES (#{name}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{description}, #{imageUrl}, #{status}, #{category})
mapper.update: UPDATE `shangpin` SET name = #{name}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, description = #{description}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, status = #{status}, category = #{category} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE `shangpin` SET stock = stock - #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND stock >= #{quantity}
UPDATE `shangpin` SET stock = stock + #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
